<style>
.scm-wrap{max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;color:#1f2d3d;line-height:1.8}
.scm-wrap *{box-sizing:border-box}
.scm-banner{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0b2a5b 0%,#1a5fb4 55%,#12a39a 100%);border-radius:14px;color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:28px 18px;margin:0 0 24px}
.scm-banner svg{width:56px;height:56px;display:block;margin:0 auto 10px}
.scm-banner .scm-title{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:1.6em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4;margin:0 0 8px;padding:0;border:0;background:none;text-decoration:none}
.scm-banner .scm-sub{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:.95em;margin:0;padding:0;opacity:.95}
.scm-wrap h2.scm-h2{color:#0b2a5b;border:0;background:none;border-left:6px solid #12a39a;padding:2px 0 2px 12px;margin:32px 0 16px;font-size:1.3em}
.scm-levels{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin:0 0 8px}
.scm-level{flex:1 1 200px;min-width:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d4e2f4;border-top:5px solid var(--c);border-radius:12px;padding:14px;text-align:center}
.scm-level .scm-ic{font-size:2em;line-height:1.2}
.scm-level b{display:block;color:#0b2a5b;margin:4px 0}
.scm-star{color:#e6a700;letter-spacing:1px}
.scm-level p{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:.92em}
.scm-card{display:flex;gap:14px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d4e2f4;border-left:6px solid var(--c);border-radius:12px;padding:16px;margin:0 0 14px}
.scm-card .scm-ic{flex:0 0 48px;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:#f3f7fc;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.5em}
.scm-card .scm-body{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.scm-card .scm-name{display:block;color:#0b2a5b;font-weight:700;font-size:1.1em;margin:0 0 4px}
.scm-card p{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:.95em}
.scm-card ul{margin:0;padding-left:1.2em}
.scm-card li{margin:2px 0}
.scm-card li.scm-off{color:#8a949e;list-style:none;margin-left:-1.2em}
.scm-info{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin:18px 0}
.scm-info div{flex:1 1 140px;min-width:0;background:#f3f7fc;border:1px solid #d4e2f4;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;text-align:center}
.scm-info small{display:block;color:#5d6d7e}
.scm-info b{color:#0b2a5b;font-size:1.05em}
.scm-step{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#f3f7fc;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;margin:0 0 10px}
.scm-badge{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:46px;text-align:center;background:#1a5fb4;color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px;font-weight:700;font-size:.9em}
.scm-step .scm-t{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.scm-step.scm-soon .scm-badge{background:#9aa5b1}
.scm-step.scm-soon .scm-t{color:#8a949e}
.scm-back{margin:24px 0 0}
.scm-card p.scm-more{margin:8px 0 0;font-weight:700}</style>
